mapper.select: SELECT m.LOGIN_ID, m.NICKNAME, m.EMAIL, m.PHONE, TO_CHAR(m.JOIN_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS JOIN_DATE, m.POINT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LIFE x WHERE x.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID AND x.STATUS = 'ENDED') AS LIFE_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LIFE_QUEST lq JOIN LIFE x ON x.LIFE_ID = lq.LIFE_ID WHERE x.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID AND lq.ACHIEVED = 'Y') AS QUEST_DONE, l.LIFE_ID, l.NAME AS LIFE_NAME, c.NAME_KO AS CURRENT_COUNTRY_NAME, l.CURRENT_AGE FROM MEMBER m LEFT JOIN LIFE l ON l.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID AND l.STATUS = 'PLAYING' LEFT JOIN COUNTRY c ON c.COUNTRY_CODE = l.CURRENT_COUNTRY WHERE m.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND m.STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
